description: This file defines a React functional component 'ErroredItems' that displays a list of items with decryption errors, allowing users to attempt decryption, export, or delete these items within a preferences/security context.

classes.name: ErroredItems
classes.description: A React functional component that displays and manages errored encrypted items with options to decrypt, export, or delete.

methods.name: getContentTypeDisplay
methods.description: Returns a formatted display string for the item's content type.

methods.name: deleteItem
methods.description: Deletes a single item after user confirmation.

methods.name: deleteItems
methods.description: Deletes multiple items after user confirmation.

methods.name: attemptDecryption
methods.description: Attempts to decrypt an item, displaying an error if unable.
